headline: Panthers’ Anton Lundell day-to-day with undisclosed injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Panthers forward Anton Lundell is day-to-day with an undisclosed injury. He has four goals and six points in 16 games this season, per the outlet.

Our numbers say Lundell has been better than that line looks. He has scored 4 goals against 4.79 expected goals, which measures the quality of the chances he has taken, so he's running slightly cold in front of the net. At 5-on-5, Florida has taken 57.73% of the expected goals while he's on the ice, and the team's share rises by 5.19 percentage points with him out there versus without him. That's real two-way value from a second-line center, and it matters for a Panthers team sitting at 9-5-2 with a 55% 5-on-5 expected goal share so far this season.

If he sits, the lineup tells us who benefits. Going by how the coach has used his players, Garnet Hathaway (10:10 a night) is next in line for Lundell's minutes. We'd expect a drop in the quality of chances for the second line, plus a thinner penalty kill, since Lundell works both.
